logo_override.validation_detail: png, probed HTTP 200 with content-type image/png (6376 bytes). Fetched the bytes through the page origin, decoded to a data URL and rendered on a white background: it is MBZUAI's brand mark, the ring of dark-navy dots forming the stylised 'AI' glyph the university uses in its own header (whose inline SVG carries the matching text-mbzuai-navy-500 utility classes). Dark navy on transparency, so it is legible on a light card.
logo_override._award: MBZUAI Graduate Funding for M.Sc. and Ph.D. Students

notes: Awarding body is MBZUAI itself, so a university mark is correct. The site is Sitefinity and returns 200 for full page navigation. INTEGRATION CAVEAT, please read before merging: mbzuai.ac. sits behind a WAF that 403s non-browser asset requests. An off-browser HTTP client (Playwright's request context, and by extension most server-side fetchers) gets '403 text/html' for the image assets, while the same URL returns 200 image/png when requested from inside the loaded page with normal browser headers. I therefore verified this URL the second way - in-page fetch of /apple-touch-icon.png, which returned 200 with content-type image/png and 6376 bytes - and decoded and rendered those exact bytes. The URL is real and correct, but if your card renderer fetches logos server-side it will likely get a 403 for this host and should have a browser-fallback or a per-host exception. Reachability summary from the same origin: /apple-touch-icon.png 200 image/png 6376B, /apple-touch-icon-152x152.png 200 image/png 5293B, /favicon.ico 200 image/x-icon 78B, but /favicon.svg 403. Rejected because they are not the institutional mark: the header logo is an inline Tailwind-styled SVG inside div.navigation-main-logo and has no probeable src at all, so per rule 5 I could not cite it; the 152x152 icon is the same glyph at lower resolution; favicon.ico is a 78-byte stub. Probed and 404: /content/media/images/logo.svg, /assets/images/logo.svg (404 application/json), /logo.svg (404 application/json). What is reported is the symbol mark rather than a wordmark because MBZUAI publishes no wordmark as a fetchable file anywhere I could reach.
